Messages.Author: David_Mac
Messages.Body:
Hi guys- question about Alan Sovereign's merged ability as I'm finding the wording a little confusing (and I'm fishing for new deck ideas)...

"[MERGED] During your master phase, if Alan is ready, you may move a counter from any investment card to your pool."

This means one counter, or one per investment card?

ie- Farm out 5 protracted investments, take on 5 blood per turn.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: One counter per turn, even if there is more than one investment card in play.

Messages.Author: Dorrinal
Messages.Body: Those counters were meant to pay for assault rifles, anyway.

Messages.Body:
vekn.net/general-rulings

"During time period X, (you may) do Y" limits Y to once per phase X."
